title: Anarchy
description: Create, destroy and fight for survival.
body:
**Anarchy.ac** is a pure anarchy Minecraft server where players have complete freedom. There are few rules, no resets and no gameplay restrictions. The world evolves entirely through player actions.

This server is designed for players who enjoy the classic anarchy experience, survival in a world where anything can happen and every decision matters.

## Features

- **Few rules** – players are free to play however they want  
- **No world resets** – the world persists and its history is shaped by the community  
- **Vanilla-focused gameplay** – minimal interference with the core Minecraft mechanics  
- **Player-driven world** – alliances, conflicts, bases and exploration are all created by players

## What to Expect

- A harsh survival environment  
- A constantly changing world shaped by players  
- The freedom to build, explore or destroy

Whether you want to create massive bases, explore distant lands or survive in chaos, **anarchy.ac** offers a raw Minecraft experience where the only limit is the players themselves.
